name: To Our Lady
source:
Magdalene has faithfully served Countess Erzabet for years. Her tasks are deceptively simple: obey her mistress, strive for perfection in her eyes, do not falter, do not trouble herself with the rabble, prepare her baths, meals, and her treatments...

It's a dangerous dance, but one Magdalene knows well; for years her steps have not faltered.

Then a new girl is brought in. A girl who threatens to upturn everything Magdalene has worked built with a mere flick of the wrist and a smile. A girl who threatens to seize her place as the Countess's favorite, and knows it. 

What is Magdalene to do?

[Edited from [url=https://butterflylattevns.itch.io/to-our-lady]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛格达琳多年来一直忠实地侍奉埃尔扎贝特伯爵夫人。她的任务看似简单：服从她的女主人，力求她眼中的完美，不犹豫，不与乌合之众纠缠，为她准备洗澡、吃饭和治疗……

这是一种危险的舞蹈，但抹大拉的人很清楚；多年来，她的脚步从未动摇过。

然后一个新女孩被带了进来。这个女孩威胁要颠覆玛格达琳仅用手腕一抖和微笑所建立的一切。一个女孩威胁要夺取伯爵夫人最宠爱的地位，而且她也知道这一点。

玛格达琳要做什么？

[编辑自[url=https://butterflylattevns.itch.io/to-our-lady]itch.io[/url]]
